alignments.note: Construct noun of the superscription; the supplied indefinite *A* belongs to the nominal expression under rule 15 and is not `added`.
Article on the nomen rectum; the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase at all (*A Song of Ascents*), so under rule 29's closing sentence the article is unrepresented rather than fronted.
Nomen rectum takes the chain's relational *of* under rule 19, headed on the noun.
Multi-word English preposition; head on the token carrying the ablative lexeme, *Out*, under rule 24.
No article morpheme stands on מַעֲמַקִּים, so the supplied *the* determines the nominal expression and joins the noun's unit under rule 15.

Finite verb with its subject pronoun and auxiliary under rule 17; the supplied *unto* is the preposition the English verb needs to reach its own object suffix, and joins the verb's unit under rule 44's suffix clause. Unit discontinuous around *thee* by rule 25.
Object suffix keeps only the pronoun written for it under rule 18; the preposition reaching it belongs to the verb.
Vocative takes the supplied *O* into its own unit under rule 36.

review_notes: Superscription and body aligned as one verse packet, as supplied.
The alternative for s006/s007 would give *unto* to the suffix; rule 44's clause on a verbal object suffix reached by a supplied preposition puts it on the verb, and that reading was taken.
